title: D-Day - Normandy Landings
description:
On June 6, 1944, Allied forces launched **Operation Overlord**, the largest seaborne invasion in history, landing on the beaches of Normandy, France.

Over 150,000 troops stormed five beaches, suffering heavy casualties but establishing a crucial foothold in Nazi-occupied Europe.

D-Day marked the beginning of the liberation of Western Europe from Nazi control.
